constraints.text: Evidence retrieval must remain a bounded child worker because it is reusable and has its own provenance responsibility.
Do not convert evidence retrieval into a generic main-flow command.
Do not invent missing contract fields.
Do not create an executable worker invocation unless the handoff contract is complete.
Do not invent the child worker input contract or output contract; keep the child worker definition as a renderable skeleton with empty INPUTS and empty OUTPUTS.
After the child worker definition exists, diagnostics may report that the invocation contract is incomplete.
